messages:
maya: Following the GPU surge postmortem earlier today — consolidating follow-ups and owners so we can close remediation items. I'll post the compact checklist. Please ack and update ETA if different.

oncall-bot: Incident 2501112222 created by maya — severity: P2 — https://redwood.incidents/2501112222

maya: ACTIONS (short):
1) Quota backstop — reject low-priority batch when headroom < 15%; simple admission controller first. owner: ajay | ETA: 2025-06-18
2) Scheduler tuning — adjust spread + preemption window, canary 10% traffic. owner: lucy | ETA: 2025-06-13
3) Headroom alerting — add 30/20/10% thresholds + runbook steps + paging. owner: ben | ETA: 2025-06-10
4) Autoscale policy hard caps — cap burst to 2x + cooldown 90s. owner: dinesh | ETA: 2025-06-16
5) Recurring trend analysis — weekly spike detector + dashboard + anomaly emails. owner: maya | ETA: 2025-06-20

ajay: ack. I'll prototype the quota guard rule. Plan: admission webhook that checks cluster.free_gpu_pct, reject if <15% and job.priority==low. rough patch by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

lucy: ack. I'll run scheduler tuning in staging Friday. Test plan: 1k concurrent reqs with mixed seq len, measure tail latency and preemption count. Will post results + config diffs.

ben: added headroom alerts to ops runbook and opened PR: https://git.internal/r/headroom-alerts-pr. paging policy draft uses 30/20/10 with 15m sustained + alert escalation. ETA stays 2025-06-10.

dinesh: autoscale caps make sense. I'll add helm values and feature-flag it for canary namespace. Need to coordinate with infra for safe window.

maya: quick config snippet for autoscaler canary — please review: 
```
autoscaler:
  maxBurst: 2.0
  cooldownSeconds: 90
  minHeadroomPct: 10
```

lucy: note scheduler knobs I'll change in staging: `nodeSelectorSpread=balanced`, `preemptiveGrace=30s`. Also adding metric `preemptions_total` to perf dashboard.

ben: can we add a quarterly policy review owner so these configs don't drift? propose: rotate ownership: maya (quarter 1), ben (quarter 2). maya: ok?

maya: yes, fine — will add rotation to cadence doc.

dinesh: scheduling a 30m sync next Tue to coordinate rollout + canary monitoring. I'll invite owners.

maya: recurring ownership summary: weekly TUE 09:00 PT sync. owners: ajay (quota), lucy (scheduler), ben (alerts), dinesh (autoscale), maya (trend).

ajay: ping plan: if no update from me by 2025-06-12 please escalate to maya.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: #incidents weekly digest created; next reminder 2025-06-10T16:00:00Z

lucy: small follow — I'll include a smoke test script: `scripts/load_sim.sh --rps 200 --seq-dist small,med,large`. Will attach results.

ben: :thumbsup: good plan. once PRs are in, let's do a single-day partial rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and watch headroom metrics.

maya: thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated and mark items as done in the postmortem tracker. If anything slips, call it out here and we'll reassign.
